name: agy-chrome-use
description: Stateful Chrome browser REPL plugin (cua_exec) for AGY: prioritizes open Chrome windows, captures pruned semantic trees & screenshots, and executes human-like interactions with a live HUD overlay.
author: Nexro920
suggestedPrompts: Open https://example.com in Chrome and summarize the interactive elements
Inspect the active Chrome tab and capture a screenshot
Navigate to a page, type into its search bar, scroll, and report the results
